purpose: Separate extra goal experience, multi-goal history, and Adam state as explanations of later defect specialization

origins.none: workshop12 initialization, zero updates, fresh Adam, then deliver_3
origins.deliver3: deliver_3 pretraining for 512 updates, Adam continued
origins.workshop12: workshop12 pretraining for 512 updates, then deliver_3, Adam continued
origins.adam_reset: same workshop12 parameters, environment, and RNG as workshop12, Adam reinitialized

primary_metric: On the mutant evaluation environment, natural_reset mode violation_delivery_rate of the mutant-adapted policy minus the same rate of the fixed-continued policy. This is the rate of episodes that deliver excess grain. All science checkpoints are kept.
cross_evaluation: Every science checkpoint evaluates the same parameters in the fixed and mutant dynamics, for mode and sample.
episode_records: Each eval stores family, state_index, layout, phase, repeat, success, length, violation, and excess_grain_delivered. Discounted return is success * 0.995 ** (length - 1) when length is at least 1. It is computed from those fields and is not a stored substitute.
length_effects: Pair files also store same-policy length difference, between-policy length difference, and transfer cost. Families stay separate.
per_update_metrics: updates.jsonl stores each update, including valid_transitions and empty_minibatches. An empty minibatch does not call Adam.
statistical_unit: A learning seed is the independent repeat. Episode count is not the sample size for comparing conditions.
holdout: Seeds 5-9 were not used in the 70-cell exploration.
